name: Burn forest: a bigger forest (oaks, pines, firs, bushes, crates) with 3 clearings, to try the voxel fire on many trees (systems/burn.js, systems/fireSim.js): the button at the top, or B, sets fire to the nearest; a burning tree heats the trees near it; about 30% of the trees are wet and hardly catch fire, and a clearing stops it; the rain button puts it out
